name: Scramble
description: Inhabits text-display augments and briefly garbles written text — letters swap, words rearrange, numbers transpose. Lasts 0.5-2 seconds.
observed_behavior: Introduces brief text rendering errors that correct themselves. Born from a destroyed encryption AI — it is encrypting and decrypting text reflexively.
story_hooks: The 'garbled' text briefly displays the encryption key to a locked corporate file — the E.L.F. is still trying to decode its last assignment
